profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a Los Angeles-based software engineer with over 10 years of experience. I like to own solutions from the moment they're born in a whiteboard (virtual or physical) until they're in production ready to be used.

I enjoy being in multidisciplinary teams that work together to solve a problem - specially with design and product teams, which is why front end has always been my passion. Nevertheless I like to be involved in the whole process of architecting a solution, from wireframes and feature design to testing and maintenance. I think it's also important to keep iterating over the existing ones (there’s always a way to make it better!)

I've worked with several JavaScript frameworks, the main one is React. I'm also skilled in CSS and have worked a great deal with it, whether it's in its pure form or frameworks like LESS, Stylus or styled components. I’ve also worked with Python frameworks like Django and Flask. In combination, I have experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, cross-browser compatibility, responsive design, different React component libraries and testing frameworks such as jest and react testing library.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Hulu I have participated in the planning, implementation and delivery of content publishing tools and workflows, as well as maintained and improved existing systems. 

I work closely with our Hulu Operations team to provide them tools for everything they need to get Hulu's content ready for production, from ingestion and review to publishing and troubleshooting. While my work has been very focused on front end and user experience I've also been part of feature design and backend development.

Skills: HTML, CSS (Stylus, Less, styled components), JavaScript (React), GraphQL (Apollo), Python (Flask), testing (enzyme, jest, pytest)

positions.title: Web UI Developer
positions.description:
At Globant I worked for Hulu as a contractor in their Content Management team. I helped provide the Product department with robust, reliable tools that allow them to upload, review, modify and monitor content. My tasks were very diverse, from helping to build an electronic programming guide to keep track of the channels and what each of them is streaming at a given moment, to the full development of a stream monitoring app. I also have helped in planning, designing and wire framing new features, collaborating with other teams inside Hulu.

Skills: HTML, CSS (Stylus), JavaScript (React), Python (Flask, Django)

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
At KamikazeLab I worked very closely with UI/UX designers and creative staff to build all kinds websites, landing pages, online stores, mailing campaigns and content management systems for brands like Chef Oropeza, Pontebuso, Jarritos, Lanix, Littmann and Centro Oncológico Internacional. The great collaboration I had with other teams helped me polish my CSS and JavaScript skills and taught me a lot about user experience basics.

Inside the dev team we had a great policy of sharing knowledge and of helping out our teammates if necessary, which allowed me to explore both front end and back end technologies.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
I developed and maintained websites and landing pages for brands like Takis, Clamato, Ben & Jerrys and Dove. I also developed several online minigames that some of these brands used for promotions and new product launches. I collaborated closely with the creative and design department in the agency, providing technical insights when necessary.

Skills: HTML, CSS, PHP, JavaScript, JQuery, mySQL, HTML5 Games (Construct2, GameSalad)

positions.title: Trainee
positions.description:
At SmarterTakeout we created personalized microsites and systems that allowed restaurants to get online orders. I planed and implemented tailored solutions for several restaurants in Mexico including front-end development of each site and desktop applications to integrate with their Point of Sale systems.

Skills: HTML, CSS, PHP, JavaScript, VB.NET

positions.title: ITS Trainee
positions.description:
As an ITServices trainee I developed desktop applications and macros that helped Finance and Accounting with their reporting and data analysis tasks. I also participated in the development and maintenance of the company website (for Mexico), making sure it was consistent with the corporate identity. 

Skills: Visual Basic.NET, VBA, SQL Server, HTML/CSS

testScores.name: EGEL - Ingeniería de software
testScores.description:
Análisis de sistemas (Computer Systems Analysis): 1164/1300
Desarrollo e implantación de aplicaciones computacionales (Development and Implementation of Computer Applications): 1205/1300
Gestión de proyectos de TI (IT Project Management): 1234/1300
Implantación de infraestructura tecnológica (Infrastructure Implantation): 1173/1300
